method_definitions.OURS-DETOUR+HMM: Phase47-C OURS-DETOUR+HMM frozen;NO graph/R2/R3,SAFE+EC+RECOVER,C0-NA PP/SP,HMM,official declared stop

interpretations.care_input: User-fixed NOMAD_RAW first sample, current-frame camera points only
interpretations.te_ec: Inspect actual ensemble steering rather than mismatched single PP trajectory
interpretations.jitter: Uniform continuous offset in [-.2,+.2]m; chosen before any driving data

care.obstacles: Current depth frame only: backproject, 0<camera axial Z<=1m, .03<world height<=.6; camera-X bins retain minimum Z
care.bin_range: Uniform valid camera-X min/max per frame; inclusive right edge; empty bins omitted
care.bins_reason: M not specified in paper; user fixed32 before smoke
care.depth_noise: Frozen common Gaussian sigma=.01*d^2, same per-frame RNG stream; no accumulation
care.single_term_magnitude: 1/d^3 mathematically; explicit vector equation takes precedence over inverse-square prose
care.sign_rationale: User-fixed repulsive intent, positive robot-plane sign instead of literal negative sign in paper equation; camera-to-robot and left/right directions unit tested
care.selected_waypoint: argmax norm(F); first index on exact tie
care.rotation: atan2(F_y,F_x), clipped to +/-pi/4; rotate all waypoints about application robot origin B; no special frontal/backward-force case
care.safe_fov: If corrected p_k* heading error >pi/6: immediate v=0 in-place rotation capped at .4rad/s; otherwise common PP/SP
differences: camera depth instead of monocular estimate
p_k* for Safe-FOV and PP lookahead .25m for translating

rtc.difference: DDPM waypoint RePaint hard-prefix+guidance, not original flow-policy soft mask

ec_extension.fallback: primary full, next SAFE FRESHEST at full, all SAFE FRESHEST at .1m/s, STOP_WAIT
ec_extension.slow_cap: until next full-speed EC-PASS FRESH installation
ec_extension.te_expiry: advance retained chunk clock by rollout time; no future NoMaD chunks invented
ec_extension.te_candidate: hypothetical accepted candidate replaces its same-ID chunk; keep other valid chunks and original weights; rejected previews do not mutate live ensemble
ec_extension.te_keep: original SAFE KEEP pruning then EC on retained ensemble; reject -> STOP_WAIT

placement_rule.distribution: Uniform(-.2,.2)m added to frozen lateral center
placement_rule.reject: wall/static overlap or widest available side gap < .28m

statistics.mcnemar: two-sided exact binomial on discordant pairs
statistics.family_scope: all 8 pairs x 2 endpoints per cumulative report; night1 interim, no sequential-error guarantee
statistics.noninferiority: OURS goal rate minus each other method, CI lower >= -0.10
statistics.bootstrap_unit: paired scene x seed; resample within scene
statistics.missing: exclude a comparison pair when either measurement technically invalid; no outcome imputation

stop.application: Every controller-delivered inference at first72Hz poll, no wait for9Hz/FRESH; D750 unchanged
stop.geometric_goal_stop: Disabled only while option is enabled; goal radius/config unchanged and distance evaluation only
stop.terminal_result: Do not install its waypoint; do not declare on post-termination drained inference
stop.collision_precedence: Frozen collision/corridor stops retain priority at the same integration tick

outcomes.success: declared arrival AND distance<=0.5m AND collision==False

localization.odometry: Recorded72Hz cumulative XY path length at observation tick; delta between accepted inference inputs,first delta0

L2.center_definition: Midpoint of static free corridor cross-section;H1 inner-corner wall included

H1.center_definition: Midpoint of static free corridor cross-section;H1 inner-corner wall included

H2.width_definition: Cross-direction only;forward thickness,height,spawn timing and surface offset frozen
H2.center_definition: Midpoint of static free corridor cross-section;H1 inner-corner wall included

report_definitions.success: Phase47 success: declared arrival at distance<=0.5m AND no collision;wrong arrival>0.5m;timeout without declaration unchanged
report_definitions.delay: Same post-inference IPC hold as D750: packet received -> release,changed only to1.5s in L150;actual network inference time is additional,not normalized
report_definitions.WIDE: Only sudden-box lateral width and center/jitter change. Thickness/height/trigger/forward-surface offset frozen;H2 both boxes centered. SLW/LC have no sudden boxes and are unchanged
report_definitions.passage: At least one full geometric side gap>=0.33m;inside corridor/no static overlap. H1 inner-corner wall included;maximum multiplier<=1.5 frozen before runs
report_definitions.stop_time: Saved72Hz actual |v|<0.01,integrated by interval;includes first inference wait,recovery/alignment and other stops
report_definitions.EC_all_rejected: Logged NORMAL_NO_EC_SAFE_CANDIDATE => no available path survives frozen full-speed then0.1m/s fallback;duration held from that decision to next EC PASS INSTALL or run end,merged across repeated rejects
report_definitions.EC_scope: Available install candidates,not necessarily all8 NoMaD samples (depth-unsafe samples were already filtered). Held last-decision state,not continuous new validation;recovery time included;no runtime change
report_definitions.EC_report: Per-run total held duration and longest continuous interval;physical-stop intersection also saved. Same reconstruction on historical Phase47 logs
report_definitions.comparison: Same scene/seed Phase47-C OURS-DETOUR+HMM adjacent columns;different execution day,no claim of isolated random effect;missing/new technical failures not zero-filled
report_definitions.summary: Counts for outcomes;medians for arrival time(successes only),stop and EC durations;per-run values also reported
report_definitions.execution: Preparation only,dry-run20,zero simulation/render/inference;main serial/one technical retry/storagev2/cache cleanup/disk30GB stop,automatic report+commit+push
